verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents GitHub's general pull request workflow and PR handling via the CLI and mobile app. Nothing in it describes stacked pull requests, per-member readiness views for a stack, or ordered merging of a stack. Generic PR features are adjacent and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can split a large change into stacked pull requests, see each member's readiness, and merge the stack in order
